# appwrite_auth_team (Resource)

Manages an Appwrite team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appwrite_team" "engineering" {
  id   = "engineering"
  name = "Engineering"
}

resource "appwrite_team" "marketing" {
  id    = "marketing"
  name  = "Marketing"
  roles = ["owner", "editor"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The team ID.
- `name` (String) The team name.

### Optional

- `roles` (List of String) Roles for new team members. Defaults to ["owner"].

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The team creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
- `updated_at` (String) The team last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import appwrite_team.engineering engineering
```
